# `pdf` — PDF chunk-extraction pipeline: CLI reference

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Rendered from the spec registry
> (`geneva_examples/examples/pdf/__init__.py`) by `geneva_examples/docs_gen/`;
> regenerate with `make docs`. The same text is shown by `uv run <command> --help`.
> Docs index: [`docs/README.md`](../../README.md).

Load your own PDFs, then extract per-page text and overlapping text chunks with Geneva's pre-built document UDFs — ready to embed or explode into a per-chunk table.

Order: **ingest-pdfs → chunk-pdfs**.

**Modality:** `pdf` · **Steps in pipeline order:** [`ingest-pdfs`](#ingest-pdfs) → [`chunk-pdfs`](#chunk-pdfs)

## Common options (every command)

Every command below is generated by `geneva_examples/core/spec.py` (`build_command`) and accepts these options in addition to its own:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | `None` | Path to config.yaml (default ./config.yaml). |
| `--mode` | choice: local \| enterprise | `None` | Connection mode: 'local' or 'enterprise'. |
| `--db-uri` | str | `None` | Override the config db_uri (enterprise mode). |
| `--log-level` | str | `INFO` | Logging level. |

A `None` default is resolved at runtime: `--mode` and `--db-uri` follow the config-file precedence, and some model steps resolve `--num-gpus None` to a per-step GPU fraction inside their `run()` (see the step's source file).

## `ingest-pdfs`

**Ingest PDFs**

Load every `*.pdf` under `--pdf-dir` into a `pdfs` table (`doc_id` + `pdf_bytes`), one fragment per PDF.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run ingest-pdfs [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | none |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/pdf/ingest.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/pdf/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `pdfs` | Table to operate on. |
| `--pdf-dir` | str | `./studio_data/pdfs` | Local directory of *.pdf files to ingest. |
| `--frag-size` | int | `1` | Rows per record batch. |
| `--overwrite` / `--no-overwrite` | flag | `--overwrite` | Drop the table first if it already exists. |
| `--table-write-retries` | int | `5` | Retries for create/add ops. |
| `--table-write-retry-sleep-s` | float | `2.0` | Base sleep (s) between table-write retries. |

## `chunk-pdfs`

**Extract pages + chunks**

Backfill `pages` (per-page text via pypdf) then `chunks` (overlapping windows via LangChain's RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter). Order matters — `chunks` reads the `pages` column. CPU pool.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run chunk-pdfs [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | run ingest-pdfs first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/pdf/chunk.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/pdf/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `pdfs` | Table to operate on. |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (minutes). |
| `--backfill-concurrency` | int | `32` | Backfill concurrency (1 locally). |
| `--backfill-task-size` | int | `256` | Backfill task size. |
| `--backfill-checkpoint-size` | int | `128` | Backfill checkpoint size. |
| `--backfill-flush-interval-s` | float | `30.0` | Batch checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--use-cpu-only-pool` / `--no-use-cpu-only-pool` | flag | `--use-cpu-only-pool` | Use the CPU-only worker pool (enterprise). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |
